name: com.indieable.sdk
description: Privacy-aware Unity client for Indieable sessions, game-scoped identity, event-bus and direct gameplay telemetry, playtest feedback, bug reports, and Community Challenges.

samples.description: Initialize Indieable locally, read the privacy manifest, establish a session, choose optional telemetry, submit feedback, and query Community Challenges.
Importable scene, GameObjects, typed gameplay events, GlobalEventBus, routing asset, UI Toolkit permission popup, and Indieable event bridge.
